messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] Document compliation problem with knitr & Lyx
parts:
1. it seems you have installed the R package tikzDevice; do you also
have the tikz package installed? sudo apt-get install pgf

If you have installed tikz, can you just run

pdflatex figure/graphics-two-high1.tikz

to see what is the error message from LaTeX? The graphics manual is a
little bit complicated. It also involves with the LaTeX animate
package, so you need to check if animate.sty is installed:

kpsewhich animate.sty

2. Yes it is a permission problem, because knitr.lyx is under
/usr/local/share/lyx/examples/ which you do not have write permission
without sudo. You can make a copy to a writable place, e.g.

cp /usr/local/share/lyx/examples/knitr.lyx ~/

then open ~/knitr.lyx and compile it.

Regards,
Yihui
